title: China’s cotton price floor is reshaping apparel sourcing
content:
China’s extension of Xinjiang cotton support pricing through 2028 strengthens supply visibility for the global cotton-to-yarn value chain amid tightening fibre markets.
Rising cotton prices and uneven downstream pass-through are reshaping sourcing economics across yarns, fabrics and apparel.
The policy reinforces China’s strategic role as a key textile input hub.

title: India, Uzbekistan sign key WTO market access protocol
content:
India and Uzbekistan have signed a protocol concluding their bilateral market access talks, a key step in the latter’s ongoing accession to the WTO, Uzbek presidential WTO envoy Azizbek Urunov announced recently on LinkedIn. 
The substantive agreements with the Indian side regarding market access were reached in 2024. 
Uzbekistan is now working to secure its full WTO membership before the end of 2026.

title: South India cotton yarn market stays bearish despite stable prices
content:
South India’s cotton yarn market remained under pressure due to weak downstream demand, falling cotton prices and cautious buying sentiment.
Yarn prices in Tiruppur and Mumbai stayed largely stable, though mills may cut prices in coming days.
A sharp reduction in CCI cotton auction prices and speculation over import duty changes further weakened market sentiment.

title: Austria’s Lenzing AG names Georg Kasperkovitz as CEO
content:
Lenzing AG has appointed Georg Kasperkovitz as chief executive officer effective June 1, 2026. 
Kasperkovitz, who has served as COO and Management Board member since June 2025, leads the Fiber Division, including sales, production, and supply chain operations, along with the company-wide performance program. 
His CEO term will continue until May 31, 2029.

title: Canada-India trade, investment forum to foster commercial alliances
content:
Canada and India have unveiled a trade and investment forum to bring together businesses from both sides to foster new commercial partnerships and increased business engagement. 
Both sides have also agreed to enhance connectivity as essential enablers of expanded trade and investment. 
A three-day visit of Indian Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal to Canada concluded recently.
